race.comment: A lot of these come through the Michael Moroney at Flemington and with a bunched finish there we've gone looking for value away from the key lead up. LARA ANTIPOVA (10) won the key lead up nicely, gear changes made after feet issues earlier in the prep that have been rectified. She carried a penalty there and gets in very well here. DIAMETER (1) had no luck behind her last time and should've gone close. Up to a mile with McDonald on looks perfect. SOMETHINGS BURNIN' (5) had his chance in third but ran well and the trip should suit. BOYS BOUNCE (8) was behind that horse on debut then won well latest, respecting with upside.
